findings: Candidate scale is unchanged and the target pans; close restores the saved view.
Mouse drag is a pure pan with no rotation, and wheel zoom works.
Hero buildings and pagodas show side faces and roof volume.
Generic massing and repeated props are visibly reduced; landmarks remain.
Explorer and information headers share brand, subtitle, typography, and active treatment.
Mobile menu uses the shared navy active state; no-JS information menu works.
Independent review P1 on 05-nanzih-landmark was fixed by reframing the park and rebuilding/repositioning the lakeside pavilion at a readable scale; the final image has a clear focal structure.
Independent review P1 on 15-mobile-menu was checked against the actual 390px screenshot and rejected: the 港 mark, full 港都人物誌 title, and district pill are visible; no clipping was reproduced.
limitations: SwiftShader only; no physical-GPU FPS claim.
Decorative harbour basin remains stylized water, not authoritative land cover.
Citywide pedestrian navigation outside the validated hero graph remains schematic.
Astro and React headers share data/CSS but remain two renderers.
The independent review was a single pass; the Nanzih P1 was corrected and visually rechecked, but no second independent reviewer pass was run.
